site.name: Saddle & Spoke
site.description: A two-bench repair workshop that publishes its job sheet as an agent network.

networks.name: saddle_and_spoke
networks.description: Describe a fault, get a diagnosis, a price and a drop-off slot written onto the shop's job sheet.
sample_queries: Third gear jumps when I push hard uphill.
The front brake rubs after I put the wheel back on.
I'm doing a 200 km ride in three weeks. What does the bike need?

llm_router.note: No funded inference endpoint is published. Without a visitor key the site replays a recorded session through the real runtime; with a key it calls the visitor's own OpenAI-compatible router and that router's model. See docs/03-INFERENCE.md.

peer_policy.note: The parts co-op is the only third party this shop talks to. The two loopback origins exist so the same build can be verified offline; nothing else is allowed.

actions.note: Registered by the page at boot. The live catalog, with effects and JSON Schemas, is in the Inspector drawer of the site and listed in docs/02-ACTIONS.md.
